description: Creates several tracks at once in the game's Music folder (created with the first track) or in one of its subfolders: free, nothing is generated. Each track has a name (what it is in the game: Main theme, Forest, Boss fight), a prompt (how it sounds, sent to the model as is: English comma-separated tags such as genre, mood, instruments, tempo), a duration, loop AND the same form as generate_music, saved on the track so the site shows it before generating: genres (musical style), bpm, key_scale, time_signature, mode, instrumental/lyrics/language, vocal_level, voice, quality (a genre and a voice are also written into the prompt as words, as the site does). A name that already exists there is UPDATED with what you send (prompt, duration, loop and the form; what you omit stays): use it to fill or fix existing tracks. Returns each track with its page and the cost of generating it, plus the total per quality level: show the user the plan and the total, and after their yes generate them (generate_music with wait=false for each, then job_status).

folder_id.description: A subfolder of the Music folder (create_folder with section "music"). Omitted: the Music folder itself.

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.

tracks.description: The tracks to create or update, 1 to 30. Creating is free; generate each one later with generate_music.

bpm.description: Compose ("Andamento"): tempo in beats per minute (60 to 180 sound best).

duration_sec.description: Whole seconds, 10 to 240 (4 min). The user's plan may allow less: the server refuses a longer track. Omitted: 1 min (or the plan limit, if lower).

genres.description: Musical style (the site's "Estilo musical"): ONE genre as a one-item list. Its words are written at the start of the prompt (empty = only your prompt).

instrumental.description: false = sung, with the lyrics below.

loop.description: true for a track the game repeats (level and menu themes). Default true.

lyrics.description: The lyrics, one line per row, parts marked with [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge]... Only with instrumental=false.

mode.description: describe = only the prompt; compose = you also set the tempo, key and meter. Omitted: compose when bpm, key_scale, time_signature, genres or sung lyrics are sent, otherwise the track keeps its current mode.

name.description: What the track is in the game (Main theme, Forest, Boss fight). Up to 60 characters; a name that already exists is updated.

prompt.description: How it sounds, sent to the model as written: English comma-separated tags (genre, mood, instruments, tempo).

quality.description: draft (fast and cheap, to test the idea), good, high (the approved default), max (large model; may be unavailable). The price per minute follows the level.

time_signature.description: Compose ("Compasso"): beats per bar (2, 3 = waltz, 4 = most music, 6 = compound like 6/8).

vocal_level.description: Sung tracks: the voice behind the band (back), even (balanced, default, adds nothing) or up front (front); written at the end of the prompt.

voice.description: Sung tracks: who sings (gender), how deep (timbre) and up to 2 singing styles, written at the end of the prompt. Omitted: the model picks.

name: create_tracks
title: Create several tracks
